✻ Baked for 6s · done 5:17 PM

❯ Write a 1500-word short story about a lighthouse keeper. No tools.

⏺ The Last Log

  Agnes Mallory had kept the light on Corran Head for thirty-one years, and in all that time she had written something
  in the log every night.

  Most entries were short. Wind SW, moderate. Visibility good. Lamp lit 18:42. Two trawlers passed north, one coaster
  south. Some were longer, from the nights when the sea came over the lower rocks and the tower shook. Those entries
  filled pages, written in pencil because ink ran when her hands were wet. The logs filled a shelf in the keeper's
  cottage, thirty-one green clothbound books with the years on their spines in her careful capitals.
  ⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?
